level.setting: A bioluminescent trench with crumbling stone pillars, ghostly schools of fish, and faint echoes of ancient civilizations. The water glows faintly with an otherworldly blue light, and pressure gauges indicate dangerously deep depths.
level.player_weapon: Geode Staff (emits seismic shockwaves and manipulates earth)

enemy.name: Stonebound Warden
enemy.weakness: Seismic shockwaves from Geode Staff

encounters.hazard: Collapsing coral arches that block progression

pickup.name: Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Increases Geode Staff's seismic damage by 30% (stacks with future pickups)

encounters.trigger: Shattering the Warden's stone core with a seismic wave reveals a hidden path through the coral maze, leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Tidal Tentacle
enemy.weakness: Resonance Crystal's amplified seismic energy

encounters.hazard: Unstable water currents that pull the player toward the temple's center

pickup.name: Tidal Core
pickup.effect: Allows the player to manipulate water currents for 10 seconds (activates during boss fight)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Tentacle's anchor with the Resonance Crystal stabilizes the temple's foundation, exposing a submerged stairway to the boss arena.

boss.name: Leviathan of the Abyss
boss.weakness: Tidal Core's manipulated currents (requires both Tidal Core and Resonance Crystal for full effect)
boss.victory_condition: Use the Tidal Core to create a vortex that traps the Leviathan, then strike its vulnerable core with the Geode Staff while the vortex is active

level.objective: Navigate a sunken labyrinth of coral and stone ruins to confront a primordial sea guardian, using geomantic abilities and pickups to overcome environmental and enemy challenges.
level.reward: Aetherium Shard (unlocks advanced geomantic ability: 'Earthquake Pulse')

level.theme: Serene Underwater Garden with bioluminescent flora, gentle currents, and hidden dangers
level.setting: Sunken coral reef with submerged ruins, soft ambient sounds of water and distant marine life

enemy.name: Aggressive Fish School
enemy.weakness: Piercing attacks (player's harpoon)

encounters.hazard: Bioluminescent Plants (dazzle the player, reducing visibility for 5 seconds)

pickup.name: Coral Shard
pickup.effect: Increases player's weapon damage by 25%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the fish, the coral shard glows, revealing a hidden path leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Giant Jellyfish
enemy.weakness: Coral Shard (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Electrical Currents (briefly paralyze the player upon contact)

pickup.name: Glowing Algae
pickup.effect: Enhances the player's companion's attack power by 50%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the jellyfish causes the glowing algae to bloom, illuminating the path to the final boss.

enemy.name: Leviathan Turtle
enemy.weakness: Glowing Algae (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Maelstrom Currents (pulls the player toward the boss, increasing damage taken)

pickup.name: Pearl of Serenity
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player's health and grants a temporary shield

encounters.trigger: The boss emerges from the depths after the algae is activated, guarding the exit to the next area.

boss.name: Leviathan Turtle
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Glowing Algae to weaken its shell

level.objective: Design an underwater game level for a Beastmaster class player with serene mood, 3 encounters, and a boss fight where each enemy's weakness is tied to prior pickups.
level.reward: Pearl of Serenity (restores health and grants a shield)

level.theme: Ominous underwater ruins with eerie bioluminescence, collapsing structures, and echoes of past necromantic failures.
level.setting: Sunken city with collapsed spires, volcanic vents, and a cursed ocean floor teeming with mutated life.
level.player_weapon: Cursed Necromancer Scythe (Deals lightning damage, can summon spectral constructs)

encounters.location: The Drowned Cathedral (First chamber of the sunken city, with collapsed pillars and flickering bioluminescent algae)

enemy.name: Spectral Drowned Knight
enemy.weakness: Lightning damage from the player's cursed scythe.

encounters.hazard: Toxic algae spores that reduce player health by 10% over time.

pickup.name: Corrupted Relic
pickup.effect: Boosts the player's scythe lightning damage by 30%, and allows summoning a spectral lightning storm (area-of-effect damage).

encounters.trigger: Destroying the knight's spectral armor with lightning reveals a sealed path to the next chamber.

encounters.location: The Abyssal Crucible (A volcanic vent chamber with boiling water and skeletal remains of failed necromancers)

enemy.name: Mutated Leviathan Eel Swarm
enemy.weakness: The Corrupted Relic (pickup from prior encounter), which disrupts the swarm's bioelectric field.

encounters.hazard: Boiling water geysers that knock the player back and deal 50 damage on contact.

pickup.name: Ancient Core
pickup.effect: A crystalline power source that, when activated, temporarily overloads the player's scythe with unstable energy (doubles lightning damage for 15 seconds).

encounters.trigger: Destroying the swarm unlocks a submerged gate guarded by the final boss, the Abominable Leviathan.

encounters.location: The Leviathan's Lair (A cavern with pressure-activated traps and a massive, pulsating heart in the distance)

enemy.name: Abominable Leviathan
enemy.weakness: The Ancient Core (pickup from prior encounter), which disrupts the leviathan's regenerative abilities.

encounters.hazard: Pressure plates that trigger collapsing rocks and water surges (deals 100 damage per second for 5 seconds).

pickup.name: Necrotic Crown
pickup.effect: Permanently increases player maximum health by 200 and grants immunity to toxic damage.

encounters.trigger: The Ancient Core must be planted in the leviathan's pulsating heart to exploit its weakness.

boss.name: Abominable Leviathan
boss.weakness: The Ancient Core disrupts the leviathan's regenerative abilities, allowing the player to land finishing blows.
boss.victory_condition: Plant the Ancient Core into the leviathan's heart while dodging its tidal waves and crushing attacks.

level.objective: Survive three encounters and defeat the final boss in a sunken, cursed city, using pickups from prior encounters to exploit weaknesses.
level.reward: Necrotic Crown (permanent health boost and immunity to environmental hazards).

level.theme: Tense, claustrophobic environments with limited visibility, eerie bioluminescence, and environmental hazards that force resource management.
level.setting: A sunken research station with collapsing structures, a vibrant yet dangerous coral reef, and a dark, abyssal trench housing the boss.

enemy.name: Corrupted Guardian Drone
enemy.weakness: Concentrated electricity attacks (player's Stormcaller weapon with Storm Capacitor pickup)

encounters.hazard: Low oxygen levels (10% of max per minute), flickering lights, and unstable floor plates.

pickup.name: Storm Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases Stormcaller's weapon damage by 150% and allows channeling lightning into a focused beam.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the drone triggers a power surge that unlocks a sealed door to the coral reef.

enemy.name: Mutated Bioluminescent Eel
enemy.weakness: Storm Capacitor (pickup from prior encounter) to overload its bioelectric shield.

encounters.hazard: Toxic algae blooms reducing oxygen by 20%, and collapsing coral structures.

pickup.name: Pressure Valve
pickup.effect: Allows the player to manipulate water pressure for environmental attacks during the boss fight.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the eel collapses the reef, revealing a hidden cave leading to the boss's chamber.

boss.name: Abyssal Leviathan
boss.weakness: Storm Capacitor (specific pickup from first encounter) to bypass the mechanical exoskeleton and damage the core. Pressure Valve (pickup from second encounter) is required to create openings in the exoskeleton during phase 2.
boss.victory_condition: Use the Storm Capacitor to power a weapon and destroy the leviathan's core.

level.objective: Navigate the sunken research station and coral reef to confront the Abyssal Leviathan, using pickups to exploit enemy weaknesses and survive the brutal encounters.
level.reward: Abyssal Core (permanent upgrade: increases Stormcaller's weapon damage by 300% and grants 100% oxygen regeneration).

level.theme: Eerie underwater ruins with ghostly echoes of drowned sailors, glowing anemone traps, and sudden bursts of phosphorescent plankton that reveal hidden paths.
level.setting: Decaying stone corridors, pressure-activated traps, and a final chamber with a pulsating energy core.
level.player_weapon: Shadow Dagger (stealth-attack weapon with a corrosive edge)

enemy.name: Corrosive Guardian
enemy.weakness: Corrosive Agent (pickup from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Bioluminescent algae creates shifting light patterns, reducing visibility.

pickup.name: Corrosive Agent
pickup.effect: Applies damage over time to enemies

encounters.trigger: Defeat the guardian to unlock a hidden map fragment pointing to the 'Abyssal Trench'.

enemy.name: Predator Eel
enemy.weakness: Shadow Dagger's stealth strike (player weapon)

encounters.hazard: Currents pull player toward the eel's nesting ground; must avoid collisions.

pickup.name: Sonic Disruptor
pickup.effect: Disables enemy movement for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Destroy the eel's nest to reveal a sealed passage leading to the 'Leviathan's Lair'.

enemy.name: Mutated Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Sonic Disruptor (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Crystalline growths emit low-frequency vibrations that drain player stamina.

pickup.name: Artifact of the Deep
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new stealth ability

encounters.trigger: Use the Sonic Disruptor during the boss fight to expose its core vulnerability.

boss.name: Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Leviathan's crystalline core using the Sonic Disruptor during a 3-second window triggered by evading its shockwave attack.

level.objective: Navigate a sunken temple complex to uncover a lost artifact, while evading eerie aquatic threats.
level.reward: Artifact of the Deep (grants temporary invisibility ability)

level.theme: Chaotic underwater ruin with environmental hazards, collapsing structures, and shifting energy fields that force the player to adapt their fire-based tactics dynamically.
level.setting: Sunken city of Thalassara, with bioluminescent algae, shattered architecture, and a mysterious void at the level's core.
level.player_weapon: Emberbrand (a fire-wreathed staff that creates unstable flame spheres, weakened by water)

encounters.location: The Molten Forge (collapsed cathedral with molten geysers)

enemy.name: Ironclad Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Emberbrand's direct fire damage (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing pillars and searing geysers deal 20 fire damage per second.

pickup.name: Thermal Conductor
pickup.effect: Absorbs environmental heat to create fire-resistant bubbles (reduces water suppression of fire by 50% for 60 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Leviathan's core destabilizes the forge, causing a chain reaction that opens the path to the next chamber.

encounters.location: The Electric Labyrinth (corrupted power conduits with unstable energy fields)

enemy.name: Stormwrecker Eel
enemy.weakness: Thermal Conductor (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Electrical storms shock the player for 30 damage per second if not protected by fire bubbles.

pickup.name: Capacitor Core
pickup.effect: Stores and redirects energy blasts; allows the player to charge their weapon with electricity for a powerful burst attack

encounters.trigger: The Eel's destruction causes the power conduits to overcharge, creating a unstable energy bridge leading to the final chamber.

encounters.location: The Abyssal Crucible (a vast chamber with a swirling void at its center)

enemy.name: Abyssal Hydra
enemy.weakness: Capacitor Core (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The void generates gravitational pulls that knock the player back and drain 10% health every 15 seconds.

pickup.name: Celestial Ember
pickup.effect: Permanently upgrades the Emberbrand to burn through water, granting +30% fire damage

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Capacitor Core to overload the Hydra's shield, revealing its core vulnerable to fire.

boss.name: Abyssal Hydra
boss.victory_condition: Use Capacitor Core to pierce shield, then finish with Emberbrand's fire burst

level.objective: Navigate the collapsing ruins of the sunken city of Thalassara, igniting ancient machinery to escape the encroaching abyssal void.
level.reward: Celestial Ember (permanent upgrade to player's weapon)

level.setting: Abandoned Mariana Trench research station with bioluminescent algae, flickering emergency lights, and toxic water leaks. The environment amplifies isolation through eerie silence and collapsing infrastructure.

enemy.name: Mutated Eel
enemy.weakness: Plasma Cutter (high-heat damage)

encounters.hazard: Toxic water plumes (5% stamina drain per second)

pickup.name: Corrosive Gel
pickup.effect: Dissolves armor (reduces enemy defense by 40% for 10 seconds)

encounters.trigger: Dissolve debris blocking the path to the Power Core Chamber

enemy.name: Iron Crustacean
enemy.weakness: Corrosive Gel (reduces armor to 20% of original value)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing structural beams (random 10% chance to trap player for 5 seconds)

pickup.name: Power Cell
pickup.effect: Powers the sonic disruptor for the final boss

encounters.trigger: Activate the sealed chamber door leading to the Leviathan's Lair

boss.name: Abyssal Leviathan
boss.weakness: Power Cell (sonic disruptor charges: 3 total, 1 charge per use; requires 3 successful hits to defeat the boss)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core using the Power Cell-powered sonic disruptor

level.objective: Secure the sunken research facility by eliminating threats and recovering a critical power cell to seal the abyssal trench.
level.reward: Sealed Trench - Facility secured, player gains 'Warden's Resolve' buff (10% damage reduction for 30 seconds after defeating the boss)

level.theme: Whimsical underwater labyrinth with bioluminescent flora, playful enemies, and light-based puzzles. Environments shift with illusion magic, creating dynamic challenges.
level.setting: A vibrant coral reef with glowing anemones, floating bubbles, and kaleidoscopic light patterns. The player's illusions interact with the environment, causing reflections, mirages, and light-based puzzles.
level.player_weapon: Prism Wand (emits concentrated light beams and refracts light into rainbow patterns)

enemy.name: Luminous Jellyfish
enemy.weakness: Intense light from the Prism Wand

encounters.hazard: Hypnotic glow causes temporary confusion (10% damage per second for 5 seconds)

pickup.name: Prismatic Prism
pickup.effect: Refracts light into multiple beams, used to break illusions and weaken enemies

encounters.trigger: The Prismatic Prism reveals a hidden coral pathway leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Mirror Mimic
enemy.weakness: Refracted light from the Prismatic Prism

encounters.hazard: Illusions create mirror clones that attack in unison

pickup.name: Bubble Wand
pickup.effect: Creates protective bubbles that deflect pressure waves and trap enemies

encounters.trigger: The Bubble Wand allows the player to navigate a dangerous current to reach the third encounter.

enemy.name: Pressure Guardian
enemy.weakness: Bubbles from the Bubble Wand

encounters.hazard: Pressure waves knock the player back and reduce health by 5 per hit

pickup.name: Aquamarine Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final gate to the boss chamber

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Pressure Guardian with bubbles reveals the Aquamarine Key, granting access to the boss.

boss.name: Shellshimmer Leviathan
boss.weakness: Prismatic Prism (refracted light disrupts the shell's magic)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by targeting its shell with the Prismatic Prism to break its reflective barrier.

level.objective: Navigate the Luminous Labyrinth, using illusion-based abilities to overcome whimsical aquatic foes and claim the Heart of the Reef.
level.reward: Heart of the Reef (restores 100% health and grants a permanent illusion ability: 'Mirage Dash' for 10 seconds)

level.theme: Chaotic jungle with dynamic hazards, organic enemies, and environmental storytelling through collapsing terrain and awakening wildlife.
level.setting: A dense, living jungle with moving plants, unpredictable weather, and a hidden, ancient core pulsing with primal energy.
level.player_weapon: Sonic Whip (emits resonant frequencies to disrupt organic matter)

enemy.name: Vine Strangler
enemy.weakness: Sonic Whip (disrupts vine growth)

encounters.hazard: Swirling fog reduces visibility by 50%

pickup.name: Sonic Resonator
pickup.effect: Amplifies Sonic Whip damage by 30% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Vine Strangler collapses the overgrown canopy, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

enemy.name: Chittering Swarm
enemy.weakness: Sonic Resonator (disrupts swarm coordination)

encounters.hazard: Toxic mist inflicts 10 damage per second

pickup.name: Beastmaster's Call
pickup.effect: Summon 3 temporary wolf allies (deal 40 damage each, 20 seconds duration)

encounters.trigger: Destroying the swarm causes the ground to quake, revealing the boss's lair beneath the jungle floor.

enemy.name: Jungle Behemoth
enemy.weakness: Beastmaster's Call (overwhelms the behemoth's armor with wolf pack attacks)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing terrain and falling debris (10% chance to trigger rockslide each turn)

pickup.name: Primal Dominance
pickup.effect: Permanently increases summoned creature damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeating the behemoth unlocks the jungle's ancient power, rewarding the player with a permanent upgrade.

boss.name: Jungle Behemoth
boss.victory_condition: Use Beastmaster's Call to summon wolves and exploit the behemoth's armor vulnerability

level.objective: Navigate the chaotic jungle, defeating three enemies and the final boss by leveraging pickups and your beastmaster abilities.
level.reward: Primal Dominance (permanent stat boost for summoned creatures)

level.theme: Mysterious jungle with ancient ruins, bioluminescent flora, and cryptic warnings etched into stone tablets.
level.setting: Dense vegetation, mist, and the distant roar of unseen creatures. The air hums with magical energy.
level.player_weapon: Bow with venom-coated arrows (upgradable with pickups).

enemy.name: Venomfang Anaconda
enemy.weakness: Poison arrows (player's current weapon)

encounters.hazard: Toxic mist reduces player movement speed by 30%.

pickup.name: Venom Vial
pickup.effect: Apply poison to arrows, increasing damage by 10% and slowing enemies.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the anaconda reveals a hidden path marked by its shed scales, leading to the Thorned Guardian's territory.

enemy.name: Thorned Guardian
enemy.weakness: Fire (via the Venom Vial's alchemical reaction with nearby flora)

encounters.hazard: Traps activated by the guardian's movement, dealing 10 damage on contact.

pickup.name: Fire Torch
pickup.effect: Ignite flammable objects; deals 20 fire damage in a 5m radius.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the guardian's thorn barrier reveals a stone tablet warning of the 'Jungle Spirit' and a rusted key.

enemy.name: Jungle Spirit
enemy.weakness: Venom Vial (direct application to its core)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ruins and shifting terrain that teleports the player to random points in the sanctum.

pickup.name: Spirit's Heart
pickup.effect: Increases player's maximum health by 20 and grants temporary invisibility.

encounters.trigger: The rusted key from the second encounter unlocks the sanctum. The spirit's core glows with a venom-like hue, hinting at its vulnerability.

boss.name: Jungle Spirit
boss.weakness: Venom Vial (specific pickup from first encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Apply the Venom Vial directly to the spirit's core during the final phase, bypassing its fire resistance.

level.objective: Navigate the Whispering Canopy, uncovering secrets while surviving encounters with jungle creatures and a powerful boss.
level.reward: Spirit's Heart (boosts health and stealth) and access to a hidden shrine for permanent weapon upgrades.

level.theme: Tense jungle exploration with environmental puzzles and resource management. Enemies react to noise, and the player must conserve limited pickups for critical moments.
level.setting: A mist-covered jungle with bioluminescent plants, crumbling stone statues, and a subterranean cave system. The air is thick with humidity and the sounds of unseen predators.
level.player_weapon: Silenced Dagger (can be coated with poison)

enemy.name: Jaguar Alpha
enemy.weakness: Poison (player's dagger with applied venom)

encounters.hazard: Dense fog limits visibility; jaguar is alerted by sound.

pickup.name: Pyro Trap Mechanism
pickup.effect: Can be armed with fire to trigger explosions.

encounters.trigger: Player steps on a hidden pressure plate, triggering the jaguar's attack.

enemy.name: Vine Guardian
enemy.weakness: Fire (Pyro Trap Mechanism from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Thorny vines entangle the player, reducing movement speed.

pickup.name: Venom Vial
pickup.effect: Coats weapon in paralytic poison (reduces enemy movement speed by 50% for 5 seconds).

encounters.trigger: Player arms the Pyro Trap, destroying the vine guardian's protective barrier.

encounters.location: Serpent's Lair - The Cave of Shadows

enemy.name: Serpent Queen
enemy.weakness: Venom Vial (specific pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling rocks and venomous mist that deals 10 damage/second.

pickup.name: Heart of the Serpent
pickup.effect: Grants permanent +20% damage to poisons and +10% evasion.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the vine guardian releases the serpent queen from her prison.

boss.name: Serpent Queen
boss.weakness: Venom Vial (must be applied directly to the dagger before the fight)
boss.victory_condition: Apply Venom Vial to dagger, then land 5 hits with poison damage.

level.objective: Navigate the jungle to retrieve the 'Heart of the Serpent', while surviving brutal encounters and solving environmental puzzles.
level.reward: Heart of the Serpent (permanent stat boost).

level.theme: Serene yet perilous; the jungle's beauty hides ancient guardians. The warden's actions restore harmony, with each encounter offering tools to progress.
level.setting: Lush greenery, gentle waterfalls, and bioluminescent flora. Sounds include birdsong and distant waterfalls, interrupted by creature noises during encounters.
level.player_weapon: Nature's Spear (base weapon: pierces plants/organic matter)

enemy.name: Viperfang Serpent
enemy.weakness: Fire-based attacks

encounters.hazard: Thick vines block the path forward.

pickup.name: Burning Ember Torch
pickup.effect: Unlocks access to the next area by burning away vines.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the serpent causes the vines to retreat, revealing a hidden path.

enemy.name: Vinebound Warden
enemy.weakness: Piercing attacks (enhanced by the Nature's Spear)

encounters.hazard: The thicket shifts and regrows vines unless burned.

pickup.name: Obsidian Stone Tip
pickup.effect: Upgrades the Nature's Spear to deal +5 piercing damage.

encounters.trigger: Using the Burning Ember Torch temporarily clears the thicket, allowing the player to confront the Vinebound Warden.

enemy.name: Jungle Guardian (Boss)
enemy.weakness: Combined fire and piercing attacks (requires both pickups)

encounters.hazard: The shrine is shrouded in toxic mist that reduces player damage by 30%.

pickup.name: Sacred Jungle Bloom
pickup.effect: Restores 50 health and purifies the shrine, ending the toxic mist.

encounters.trigger: The Vinebound Warden's defeat reveals the corrupted shrine, but the Guardian's armor requires both the upgraded spear and the torch to penetrate.

boss.name: Jungle Guardian
boss.weakness: Armor weak to fire and piercing damage (requires both pickups from prior encounters)
boss.victory_condition: Deal 60 damage using both the Obsidian Stone Tip (piercing) and Burning Ember Torch (fire).

level.objective: Restore balance to the sacred jungle by purifying a corrupted guardian.
level.reward: Sacred Jungle Bloom (restores health and purifies the area), +10 max health, and a permanent 'Jungle Guardian' title.

level.theme: A cursed temple deep in a haunted jungle, where the air hums with dark energy and the trees whisper warnings. The necromancer's presence awakens ancient spirits, making the environment a living threat.
level.setting: Dense, mist-covered jungle with ancient stone ruins. The air is thick with the scent of decay, and the sounds of distant howls and rustling leaves create an atmosphere of dread.
level.player_weapon: Bone Staff of the Necromancer (emits dark energy, can summon undead minions)

enemy.name: Cursed Jaguar Spirit
enemy.weakness: Bone Staff of the Necromancer (dark energy disrupts its spectral form)

encounters.hazard: The jungle thickens with mist, reducing visibility by 30%.

pickup.name: Talisman of the Underworld
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to disrupt magical barriers (used in the next encounter).

encounters.trigger: After defeating the jaguar, the mist clears, revealing a path to the temple's inner courtyard.

enemy.name: Vinebound Shaman
enemy.weakness: Talisman of the Underworld (shatters the shaman's plant-based magic)

encounters.hazard: The ground is covered in thorny vines that deal 10 damage per second on contact.

pickup.name: Soulbound Amulet
pickup.effect: Absorbs enemy souls to temporarily boost the player's health by 25%.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the shaman causes the vines to wither, exposing a hidden stairway leading to the temple's heart.

enemy.name: Spirit of the Jungle
enemy.weakness: Soulbound Amulet (binds the spirit's essence to the amulet, weakening it)

encounters.hazard: The temple quakes with each attack, causing random collapses that reduce player movement speed by 50%.

pickup.name: Cleansing Crystal
pickup.effect: Permanently removes the jungle's corruption from the player's area.

encounters.trigger: The amulet's activation during the fight reveals the spirit's true form, initiating a final phase where the player must use the amulet to channel the Bone Staff's power.

boss.name: Spirit of the Jungle
boss.weakness: Soulbound Amulet (absorbs the spirit's essence, making it vulnerable to dark energy)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the spirit using the Soulbound Amulet to weaken it, then strike with the Bone Staff.

level.objective: Navigate a cursed jungle temple to uncover the source of a dark corruption, facing three encounters and a final boss. Each enemy's weakness ties to the player's gear or pickups obtained from prior encounters.
level.reward: Cleansing Crystal (removes curse from the jungle, unlocks the next level)

level.theme: Whimsical jungle with talking plants, bioluminescent flora, and mischievous wildlife.
level.setting: A vibrant, overgrown area filled with floating mushrooms, giggling monkeys, and vines that move like serpents.
level.player_weapon: Alchemical Satchel (holds potions, bombs, and ingredients)

enemy.name: Giggling Gorilla
enemy.weakness: Potion crafted from Glowing Mushroom (pickup from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Tangleweed vines that slow movement

pickup.name: Glowing Mushroom
pickup.effect: Craft a 'Fungal Blast Potion' (30 damage) in the Alchemical Satchel

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Gorilla, the vines retract, revealing a path to the next area.

enemy.name: Tanglebeast
enemy.weakness: Smoke Bomb (crafted with Glowing Mushroom from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing stone pillars that drop rocks

pickup.name: Smoke Bomb
pickup.effect: Create a smokescreen to evade attacks for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Tanglebeast causes the cavern’s ceiling to collapse, revealing a glowing portal to the boss arena.

enemy.name: Jesterbark
enemy.weakness: Smoke Bomb (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: Animated flowers that shoot pollen clouds (slow player)

pickup.name: Jesterbark’s Token
pickup.effect: Unlocks a permanent 'Whimsy Ward' buff (20% damage reduction)

encounters.trigger: The boss taunts the player with riddles; answering correctly with the Smoke Bomb at the right moment weakens it.

boss.name: Jesterbark
boss.weakness: Smoke Bomb (must be used during the boss’s third phase)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Jesterbark using the Smoke Bomb during its 'Pollen Storm' attack phase.

level.objective: Navigate the Whimsical Wilds and defeat the mischievous jungle guardian, Jesterbark.
level.reward: Jesterbark’s Token (permanent buff) and a map to the next level: 'The Enchanted Ruins'.

level.theme: Eerie jungle with distorted time effects, decaying ruins, and ghostly whispers. The environment reacts to the player's time powers, warping reality as the player progresses.
level.setting: A dense, fog-shrouded jungle with overgrown ruins and flickering temporal anomalies. The air hums with static, and shadows move independently of light sources.
level.player_weapon: Chronogun (fires time-fragment projectiles that slow enemies and reveal hidden paths)

enemy.name: Entangled Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Chronogun's time-fragment projectiles (player weapon)

encounters.hazard: Fog distorts time, causing random slowdowns and ghostly echoes of the player's past actions.

pickup.name: Temporal Crystal
pickup.effect: Increases Chronogun's damage by 20% and allows rewinding 3 seconds of combat.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Entangled Sentinel causes the fog to part, revealing a hidden path marked by glowing temporal runes.

enemy.name: Shattered Chronos
enemy.weakness: Temporal Crystal (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The ground shifts between past and present states, creating pitfalls and time loops that trap the player in repeated 5-second sequences.

pickup.name: Echo Shard
pickup.effect: Allows the player to briefly pause time for 2 seconds, bypassing enemy attacks.

encounters.trigger: Defeating Shattered Chronos stabilizes the timeline, revealing a fractured stone door that glows with the Echo Shard's energy.

enemy.name: Chronos Warden
enemy.weakness: Echo Shard (pickup from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The boss manipulates time to summon duplicates of itself, creating a maze of overlapping timelines.

pickup.name: Eternal Tempo
pickup.effect: Permanent boost: Chronogun damage increased by 30%, and time rewind duration doubled.

encounters.trigger: Using the Echo Shard during the boss fight disrupts its temporal loops, collapsing the maze into a single timeline for the final confrontation.

boss.name: Chronos Warden
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Warden's core by targeting its temporal anchor while under the effect of the Echo Shard's time pause.

level.objective: Navigate the eerie jungle to confront the Chronos Warden, using time-altering abilities and pickups to overcome enemies and the final boss.
level.reward: Eternal Tempo (permanent upgrade to time-manipulation abilities)

level.theme: Desolate jungle with overgrown ruins, eerie silence, and corrupted wildlife. The environment shifts from decaying tombs to toxic overgrowth, culminating in a metallic, industrial boss arena.
level.setting: A forgotten jungle where civilization was swallowed by nature. The air is thick with humidity, and the ground is littered with broken stone tablets and skeletal remains of past explorers.
level.player_weapon: Bonecrusher Cleaver (melee weapon with bone-crushing impact)

enemy.name: Scarab Lord
enemy.weakness: Joints can be shattered by bone-crushing impacts (player's weapon).

encounters.hazard: Collapsing tomb ceiling

pickup.name: Fossilized Bone Shard
pickup.effect: Can cut through organic barriers and weaken enemies' structural integrity.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Scarab Lord, the tomb collapses, revealing a hidden path through dense vines.

enemy.name: Vine Warden
enemy.weakness: Roots can be severed with the Fossilized Bone Shard.

encounters.hazard: Toxic spores from the jungle flora

pickup.name: Jungle Bloom
pickup.effect: Corrosive properties that dissolve metallic armor when applied.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Vine Warden, the vines retract, exposing a metallic gate leading to the boss arena.

boss.name: Jaguar Titan
boss.weakness: Exposed joints (crush with Bonecrusher Cleaver) and metallic armor (corrode with Jungle Bloom).
boss.victory_condition: Corrode the Titan's metallic exoskeleton using the Jungle Bloom, while shattering its joints with the Fossilized Bone Shard.

level.objective: Survive the desolate jungle and defeat the Jaguar Titan, using pickups from prior encounters to exploit weaknesses.
level.reward: Ancient Jungle Amulet (increases player's melee damage by 25% for 10 seconds on enemy hits).
